name: untapped-resume
description: Build a source-backed resume, portfolio and LinkedIn kit for one job from local evidence. Free. Adds no ads, links or credit lines to your documents. Cannot post to LinkedIn; paste + upload takes about 2 minutes. Does not guarantee interviews.

interface.shortDescription: Tailor a resume and portfolio to one job, with evidence
interface.longDescription: Reads your project files, git history, old resumes and LinkedIn export locally. Helps your agent match one job, write a plain resume and portfolio, and prepare a LinkedIn kit, cover letter and gap plan. Missing evidence stays missing. Your documents carry no ads, links or credit line for us or anyone else. Cannot post to LinkedIn; paste + upload takes about 2 minutes. Does not guarantee interviews.
defaultPrompt: Tailor my resume to this job using my project folder
Build a portfolio from my three most relevant projects
Check my resume for missing evidence and job requirements
